text: {"lessons":["I should avoid panic-selling after sharp declines; selling at large losses can lock them in, so I need a plan based on my goals and the reasons I invested.","I should not keep adding to a holding just because its price has risen; check whether each purchase fits a diversified, deliberate plan.","A few months of account results are not enough to judge my strategy, so I should stay patient and make decisions consistently with my ten-year goal."]}
